zh-Hans: 3D 预览可按轴旋转、翻面及还原方向，并支持更多 STEP 文件。
加快文件动态摘要读取，目录详情支持展开或隐藏已删除文件。
修复移动或改名后路径过时、文件误标为已删除以及搜索遗漏的问题。
en: Rotate, flip, or reset models in 3D previews and open more STEP files.
Load activity summaries faster and show or hide deleted files in folder details.
Keep activity paths and search results up to date when files move or folders are renamed.
